evidences.evidence_quote: Recent studies have demonstrated the feasibility of using mmWave radar for side-channel attacks by capturing acoustic or mechanical vibrations to reconstruct private information [6, 10, 13, 17, 18, 26, 28, 35, 41, 49].
evidences.evidence_context: Recent studies have demonstrated the feasibility of using mmWave radar for side-channel attacks by capturing acoustic or mechanical vibrations to reconstruct private information [6, 10, 13, 17, 18, 26, 28, 35, 41, 49]. These attacks can be categorized based on acoustic source types: active acoustic sources (e.g., loudspeakers, human throats) and passive acoustic sources (e.g., tables, light bulbs). Active-source attacks directly detect vibrations from the speaker or device.

evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 该引用出现在一段列举多个mmWave雷达窃听工作的句子中，且引用标记[35]（可能对应目标论文）是众多参考文献之一，原文并未单独描述目标论文或其sub-mm能力。属于普通相关工作列举，不应视为能力佐证。 原文证据句引用了其他编号，没有引用目标论文编号。
